{{Top|leg}}
'''Nylonite''' was a material that was used to make [[Cargo netting|netting]] to secure cargo containers. The ''[[Long Shot]]'' was equipped with nylonite netting, which was strong enough to restrain cargo even during violent flight maneuvers.<ref name="SWCP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>
